quick_facts.one_line: Store entity and CRUD endpoints — the root tenant scope for all business data.
quick_facts.status_reason: Sprint 1 complete. StoresModule implemented: CRUD, taxCode immutability, deactivation cascade.

content.title: Store Management
content.tldr: An admin creates and manages stores. Every user belongs to one store. All downstream entities (Product, Order, Invoice) are query-scoped to storeId. Store has a Vietnamese tax code (mã số thuế).
content.summary: The Store entity is the root of multi-tenancy in this system. All data is owned by a store. Admin users can create, update, and deactivate stores. The storeId from the JWT payload is used as the implicit filter on all other queries — no data leaks across store boundaries.

conditions: You only need to know what storeId looks like on the User — read entity-registry.json
You are working on Product/Order and just need to know the Store FK — read api-contracts/store.json

do_not: Do NOT allow a non-admin to create or deactivate a store
Do NOT expose stores from other tenants in any API response
Do NOT allow deletion — only soft-deactivation (isActive = false)
Do NOT accept taxCode without format validation (10 digits or 10-3 digits)

items.i_want: to create a new store with its legal name, tax code, and address
items.so_that: the store can begin onboarding staff and processing transactions
acceptance_criteria: Given valid name, taxCode, address — When POST /api/v1/stores by admin — Then 201 with store object { id, name, taxCode, address, isActive: true, createdAt }
Given taxCode not matching /^\d{10}(-\d{3})?$/ — When POST /api/v1/stores — Then 400 'Invalid tax code format'
Given taxCode already registered to another store — When POST /api/v1/stores — Then 409 'Tax code already registered'
Given caller is not admin — When POST /api/v1/stores — Then 403
Given name is empty or missing — When POST /api/v1/stores — Then 400 validation error
Given address is empty or missing — When POST /api/v1/stores — Then 400 validation error
edge_cases: Name contains Vietnamese diacritics (e.g. 'Cửa hàng Hà Nội') — stored and returned exactly as entered
Admin creates store but assigns no users yet — store exists as empty, valid state
business_rules: BR-STORE-01: taxCode must match Vietnamese MST format: /^\d{10}(-\d{3})?$/
BR-STORE-02: taxCode is IMMUTABLE after creation — it is a legal identifier
BR-STORE-03: taxCode must be unique across all stores in the system
BR-STORE-04: isActive defaults to true on creation

items.i_want: to view my store's full registered details
items.so_that: I can verify the name, tax code, and address that appear on invoices
acceptance_criteria: Given valid JWT with storeId — When GET /api/v1/stores/me — Then 200 with { id, name, taxCode, address, isActive, createdAt }
Given storeId in JWT references a deleted/non-existent store — When GET /api/v1/stores/me — Then 404 'Store not found'
Given no/invalid JWT — When GET /api/v1/stores/me — Then 401
Given caller from store A — Then response ONLY contains store A data (never store B)
edge_cases: Store is isActive=false but user's JWT is still valid (race condition) — return 200 with isActive: false field visible
business_rules: This endpoint uses storeId from JWT — no :id path param needed
All roles can call /stores/me — it is read-only and scoped to self

items.i_want: to update a store's name or address
items.so_that: I can correct errors or reflect a store relocation
acceptance_criteria: Given valid storeId and updated fields (name and/or address) — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id by admin — Then 200 with updated store
Given taxCode included in request body — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id — Then 400 'Tax code cannot be changed'
Given storeId not found — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id — Then 404
Given caller is not admin — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id — Then 403
Given store-manager calls PATCH — Then 403 (only admin can update)
edge_cases: Patch body is empty {} — return 200 with no changes (idempotent)
Patch includes unknown fields — silently ignored (whitelist validation)
business_rules: taxCode field in PATCH body must be rejected with 400 — not silently ignored
Only name and address fields are patchable

items.i_want: to deactivate a store that has closed
items.so_that: its staff can no longer log in and no new transactions can be processed
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid storeId — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id/deactivate by admin — Then 200, store.isActive=false
Given store is already deactivated — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id/deactivate — Then 200 (idempotent)
Given caller is not admin — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id/deactivate — Then 403
Given storeId not found — When PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id/deactivate — Then 404
After deactivation — When any user of that store attempts login — Then 401 'Store is deactivated'
After deactivation — When any user of that store makes request with existing JWT — Then 401 on next request (checked in JwtStrategy.validate)
edge_cases: Store has active orders in 'processing' state when deactivated — those orders are NOT cancelled automatically (order module handles its own state; deactivation is a store-level flag only)
Admin's own store is deactivated — admin loses access too (self-lockout risk, documented)
business_rules: Deactivation is soft — isActive=false, no row deletion
All users belonging to the store have their Redis refresh tokens flushed on deactivation (flush by storeId pattern)
Reactivation: PATCH /api/v1/stores/:id/reactivate — admin only, sets isActive=true

items.i_want: to list all stores in the system
items.so_that: I can manage and audit all registered retail locations
acceptance_criteria: Given valid admin JWT — When GET /api/v1/stores — Then 200 with array of all stores (active and inactive)
Given caller is not admin — When GET /api/v1/stores — Then 403
Given no stores exist — Then 200 with empty array []
edge_cases: Pagination not required in Sprint 1 (store count is low). Accept up to 100 stores.
business_rules: Non-admin roles NEVER see other stores' data — this endpoint is admin-only

sections.heading: Business Rules — Consolidated
items: BR-STORE-01: taxCode format must be /^\d{10}(-\d{3})?$/ — validated on create
BR-STORE-02: taxCode is immutable after creation — PATCH rejecting taxCode field with 400
BR-STORE-03: taxCode unique across system — 409 on duplicate
BR-STORE-04: isActive=false on store — all users of that store get 401 on login
BR-STORE-05: Deactivation flushes all Redis refresh tokens for that store's users
BR-STORE-06: Store name may contain Vietnamese diacritics — UTF-8 stored as-is
BR-STORE-07: storeId in JWT is the authoritative scope — all downstream queries filter by it
BR-STORE-08: No hard-delete — soft deactivation only

sections.heading: Data Scoping Contract
sections.body: Every module that creates business entities (Product, Order, Invoice) MUST filter all queries by storeId taken from request.user.storeId (JWT payload). This is enforced at the service layer — NOT the controller. The storeId from the URL or body is ignored and overridden by the JWT value to prevent cross-store injection.

items.question: Should store-manager be allowed to update their own store's name/address?
items.decision: Admin only in Sprint 1. Extend to store-manager in a future sprint after role permissions are stable.

items.question: Should deactivating a store cancel all in-progress orders?
items.decision: No — order state machine handles itself. Deactivation only blocks new logins and new orders.

approval.notes: Approved at Sprint 1 planning. Required before Product, Order, and Invoice features.
